subject: OCCURS clause
notes: kb/Work PB565 (vertical axis). 'Any PICTURE, USAGE, SIGN, VALUE, JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO, or GROUP INDICATE clauses have the same effect on each repetition as they would on a single data item without the OCCURS clause. This applies also to any SOURCE, SUM, or PRESENT WHEN clauses if no VARYING clause is present' holds BY CONSTRUCTION on both axes now, because the replay runs the whole clause binder again per repetition rather than teaching any clause about repetition - so a vertical repetition inherits exactly what a horizontal one does. The vertical golden measures VALUE (lines 2/4/7, 16/18/20, 21-26, 27-29), SOURCE with a VARYING counter (lines 9/11/14 - the rule's own exception) and PICTURE on every one.
